submission.natural_language_explanation: A lexical detector for the word 'reform' itself (the GPT-2 token ' reform', including as the stem of ' reform'+'er'), firing on that token in roughly 0.75-1.0 x max whenever it means deliberately improving an institution, policy or person (tax/ethics/prison reform, 'promised to reform the agency', reform school, a thief vowing to reform). It fires only weakly (~0.15-0.45) when ' reform' means physically re-forming ('clouds/droplets/crystals reform into...'), at about half strength on variants (' reforms' ~0.65, ' reforming' ~0.57, capitalised 'Reform'/'form' ~0.5, ' reformed' ~0.3), and faintly (<=0.3) on near-synonyms of institutional improvement (' overhaul', ' modernization', ' improvements', ' upgrade', 'reformation'); it is zero on every other token, including plain synonyms like improve, reshape, rules, cuts, funding.
